arguments.content:
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

reader1 = PdfReader("report_part1.pdf")
reader2 = PdfReader("report_part2.pdf")

writer = PdfWriter()
for page in reader1.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)
for page in reader2.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

with open("combined_report.pdf", "wb") as output:
    writer.write(output)

print(f"Merged {len(reader1.pages)} pages from report_part1.pdf and {len(reader2.pages)} pages from report_part2.pdf")
print("Output: combined_report.pdf")

from pypdf import PdfReader

reader = PdfReader("combined_report.pdf")
print(f"combined_report.pdf - pages: {len(reader.pages)}")
for i, page in enumerate(reader.pages):
    text = page.extract_text()
    print(f"Page {i+1} preview: {text[:80] if text else '(no text)'}")
